name: CAMI Taxonomic Benchmark (OPAL)
description: Compare completed MetaPhlAn profiles with a supplied CAMI taxonomic Ground Truth; never used for profiling reads.

groundTruthFile.title: Ground Truth profile file
groundTruthFile.description: Absolute path to a CAMI taxonomic profile on the execution host. Not a genome, assembly or read-to-genome mapping file.

sampleMap.title: Ground Truth sample mapping (JSON)
sampleMap.description: Explicit SeqDesk sample code → Ground Truth SampleID mapping, e.g. {"sample_0":"exact ID in reference"}. Every selected sample is required.

predictionRunIds.title: Prediction run IDs
predictionRunIds.description: Comma-separated completed MetaPhlAn run IDs. Leave blank only when exactly one run is available. Each chosen run must cover all selected samples.

taxonomyNote.title: Reference / taxonomy provenance
taxonomyNote.description: Document CAMI challenge, dataset, read technology, Ground Truth version, database taxonomy and any limitations (novel species or changed IDs).

taxonomyConfirmed.title: I checked sample identity and taxonomy compatibility
taxonomyConfirmed.description: Required. Matching taxon identifiers alone cannot prove compatible taxonomies or abundance definitions.

normalize.title: Normalize profiles in OPAL
normalize.description: Default off. Normalization changes abundance denominators; the choice is recorded.
